The industry gap

Traditional EDA starts too late.

Semiconductor programs still rely on static documents, manual interpretation, and disconnected handoffs between architecture, design, verification, and validation.

Static specifications

PDF, DOCX, presentations, tables, and diagrams contain critical intent but are not executable.

Manual translation

Each downstream team independently interprets requirements, creating ambiguity and duplicated effort.

Late discovery

Specification gaps and behavior mismatches often surface only during verification or silicon bring-up.

EFS execution model

One continuous engineering thread.
